entities.name: HyKGE
entities.description: A method that utilizes a large model to generate hypothesis output for questions and concatenates it with the query for retrieval.

entities.name: Golden-Retriever
entities.description: A method that recognizes jargon in queries and retrieves explanations to supplement the query.

entities.name: Query Decomposition
entities.description: A technique that breaks down user queries into smaller, specific sub-queries to alleviate complexity and ambiguity.

entities.name: Knowledge Enhancement
entities.description: A strategy employed after initial retrieval to refine results through knowledge merging and pruning.

entities.name: Knowledge Merging
entities.description: A process within knowledge enhancement that compresses and aggregates retrieved information from multiple sources.

entities.name: KnowledgeNavigator
entities.description: A method that merges nodes and condenses retrieved sub-graphs through triple aggregation to enhance reasoning efficiency.

entities.name: Subgraph Retrieval
entities.description: A method that retrieves top-k paths from topic entities and merges same entities from different subgraphs to form a final subgraph.

relationships.description: KnowledgeNavigator applies knowledge merging by condensing retrieved sub-graphs through triple aggregation.
Subgraph Retrieval applies knowledge merging by merging same entities from different subgraphs.
Knowledge merging is a component of the knowledge enhancement strategy.
